descriptions.text: Two-treatment crossover study, healthy subjects (N=14) received apixaban 2.5 mg twice daily (BID) and rivaroxaban 10 mg once daily (QD) for 4 days with a >4.5-day washout.
A total of 14 healthy subjects (eleven male, three female) were enrolled and received study medication.
Subjects were also excluded for a recent history of smoking or alcohol abuse.
Female subjects were excluded if pregnant or breastfeeding
Healthy subjects (N=14) received apixaban 2.5 mg twice daily (BID) and rivaroxaban 10 mg once daily for 4 days followed by a $4.5-day washout before receiving the alternate treatment
